summary: The agent successfully sets up a K-Fold ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost classifiers to generate test predictions, but completely fails to evaluate the models on the validation folds, providing no internal metric of generalisation. Furthermore, the agent misses the opportunity to use early stopping for the GBDTs, performs imputation before the CV split (causing validation leakage), and relies on a naive ensemble average without attempting any feature engineering.
